gesstabs.diagnostics.enabled.description: Flag documented GESStabs pitfalls (empty varlist, unmatched #MACRO/#IFDEF blocks, duplicate declarations, inverted RECODE bounds, CARD/CARDS ordering, WEIGHTCELLS percentages, CELLSET element allow-list, INVERTOUT+UPDATEINVERT, #define/#ifdef case mismatches).

gesstabs.debugMode.description: Enable debug messages in the console.

gesstabs.hover.enabled.description: Master switch for all GESStabs hovers. Turn this off to disable hovers entirely, regardless of gesstabs.hover.show.

keywords.description: Hover a GESStabs keyword to see its syntax and manual description.

variables.description: Hover a variable to see where it comes from and its VARTEXT / VARTITLE / VALUELABELS (pick which blocks with gesstabs.hover.variableContent).

tableDefaults.description: Hover a TABLE / OVERVIEW / XOVERVIEW keyword to see the effective CELLELEMENTS / FRAMEELEMENTS defaults.

enumDescriptions: Expanded macro body with blank and comment-only lines removed.
Expanded macro body exactly as the macro's source is written.
macros.description: Hover a #name(...) call to see its expanded body (and a bare #name to see its #EXPAND value). "short" trims blank / comment-only lines from the body, "full" keeps them.

gesstabs.hover.show.markdownDescription: Which GESStabs hovers are shown. `#gesstabs.hover.enabled#` must be on for any of these.

definition.description: The variable's origin — its SINGLEQ / COMPUTE / … declaration line, or "aus <datei>.sav (SPSS, Spalte N)" for a raw dataset variable.

gesstabs.hover.variableContent.markdownDescription: Which blocks the variable hover shows (always in this order: definition, VARTEXT, VARTITLE, VALUELABELS). Needs `#gesstabs.hover.show#` → `variables` on.

enumDescriptions: Use VS Code's own display language (German if it starts with "de", English otherwise).
gesstabs.hover.language.description: Which manual's descriptions to show for GESStabs keyword hover/autocomplete. If a keyword is only documented in the other language, that one is shown instead of nothing.

gesstabs.autocomplete.enabled.description: Suggest GESStabs keywords, previously-defined variable/table names, and macro names while typing.

gesstabs.dataInput.entryScriptPatterns.description: Filename patterns (case-insensitive globs) for the entry .tab scripts whose CSVINFILE/SPSSINFILE/DATAFILE statements are read to recover the dataset's raw variable names. Every .tab matching any pattern that isn't itself INCLUDEd by another is treated as an independent program with its own data source. Narrow this list to exclude helper .tab files; an empty list disables reading external variable names.
